description: Mission-author live-verify (bramble d05, ride, haunch peak): DEV TELEPORT drops Pip within RIDE_DEFAULT_TRIGGER_RADIUS of d05's placement while the ride loop is already mid-drift (it's been looping since world _ready(), never gated -- see mission_driver.gd _process_ride).
